description:
Operates the capture queue (buffer.md). Entries are added here, then flushed into per-thread daily logs.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT [--date D] — add an UNKNOWN raw capture. It blocks tend and flush until converted.
  add-text THREAD TEXT [--date D] — add a TEXT observation
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date D] — add a REF pointer to another vault file
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due D] [--scheduled D] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] [--date D] — add an ACTION. Same as `tasks add`.
  list [FILTER] [--json] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove one line
  tend — regroup entries by thread and date, and validate. Idempotent.
  flush — tend, write entries to logs/, then clear the buffer

Flags:
  global (before the subcommand):
    --quiet  suppress info output
  every add*:
    --date YYYY-MM-DD  file under the day the thing happened, not today
  add-action:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD
    --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8  an 8-char uuid from `tasks list`; repeatable
  list:
    FILTER  only lines containing this text; case-insensitive
    --json  JSON output

Args:
  THREAD       thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
  TEXT         for add-action, '(Assignee) description' or just 'description'
  TARGET       notes/STEM, logs/PATH, people/NAME, hours/Kind/Thread, payments/Kind/Thread, or Kind/Thread
  LINE_NUMBER  integer from `buffer list`

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/SGB", "Join semantics on multi-repo commits still unresolved"]
  ["add-ref", "Projects/SGB", "notes/2026-09-10-14-30-00", "kickoff meeting"]
  ["add-action", "Projects/SGB", "(Jane Doe) Circulate minutes", "--due", "2026-10-03"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Never edit buffer.md directly.
  Prefer add-text, add-ref or add-action over add. To convert an UNKNOWN entry, rm its line and re-add it with the right add-* command.
  Run `buffer list` before rm: tend and flush regroup lines, so line numbers change.
  flush writes log files and empties the buffer. It fails while any entry is invalid.
  After flush, run `tasks ingest` to anchor new ACTIONs.
  Exit code 1 means: a bad line number, a validation failure, or another error.
